mprQRCode.Description: Generating QR codes from links in element type parameters
mprQRCode.t1: The list shows parameters with the "URL" data type bound to element types: shared parameters and project parameters.
mprQRCode.t2: The list shows parameters with the "Image" data type bound to element types: shared parameters and project parameters.
mprQRCode.t3: There are no parameters with the "Image" data type bound to types in the document. Add a shared parameter or a project parameter bound to types.
mprQRCode.t4: Affects the image resolution, but not the code size in the schedule — the size there is set by the column settings.
mprQRCode.t5: The higher the value, the better the code reads when printed, but the larger the project file size.
